voice.name: Open Sector - Apocalypse
voice.description: Huge booming male tank commander in his fifties, enormous chesty bass voice, domineering and theatrical, speaks like a warlord who owns the battlefield, slow heavy emphasis on every word, rumbling and menacing with a hint of grim humor, heard over a powerful tank radio.
voice.sample: Apocalypse rolling. Twin guns, steel walls, and nothing on this field can stop me. Clear the road, little ones. When I arrive, the battle is already over. Bow before the heavy armor.

fire.prompt: Two massive tank cannons firing one right after the other on a World War 2 battlefield, a pair of deafening booms half a second apart, rolling and echoing across an open field.

move.prompt: Gigantic super-heavy tank diesel engine roaring to life and enormous steel tracks grinding and squealing forward, ground rumble, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Enormous super-heavy tank exploding, colossal ammunition cook-off blast, heavy armor plates tearing and crashing, long rumble with fire, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Rotary 20mm gatling anti-aircraft cannon firing a fast short burst, rapid buzzing roar of shots with brass casings clinking, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
